{"content":[{"type":"text","text":"Bias-cut maxi dress, V-neckline, floaty short sleeves, floor-skimming length, in sage green (#7D8F7A), silk satin with a soft sheen

Envelope clutch, small, in champagne (#CDB892), satin with a fine metal clasp

Drop earrings, slim and elongated, in soft gold (#C9A227), polished metal

This outfit is formal enough for a sister's wedding, with a noble fabric and a dressy floor-length cut, yet it stays breathable and light for an August afternoon. Sage green looks soft in daylight and photographs well, and it stays well away from white, ivory and anything that competes with the bride. The bare arms are the only open area, so the look stays elegant and comfortable outdoors.
